listing.name: Additional Console Commands
listing.summary: A few extra console commands. Presently includes the following:
listing.aiSummary: Adds numerous console commands for managing factions, colonies, ships, items, and alliances.

description:
A few extra console commands. Presently includes the following:

- AnnexFaction: Takes the all of the colonies from the first faction and gives them to the second faction.
- AnnexSystem: Give a target system, an annexing faction, and an optional victim faction to transfer ownership of all colonies to the annexing faction. Specifying a victim faction restricts the targeted colonies to theirs.
- CleanseSystem: Applies the Destroy, Deciv, or Wipe effects from DestroyFaction to all colonies in a specified system. Indiscriminate targeting for now.
- DestroyFaction: Simply speaking, the DestroyColony command applied to all of a given faction's markets. Supports optional arguments Deciv and Wipe: former should be obvious, latter removes the ruin conditions left behind after destroying a colony. Similar to DestroyColony there are no checks for story essential planets. Use judiciously.

- FindBPs: A command that produces a list of blueprint packages sorted by which ones you have and haven't learned.
- FindFactionBPs: Displays a list of ships/wings/weapons that the specified faction knows.
- FindHullmods: Produces a list of unlearned hullmods.
- FindRareBPs: Displays a list of rare blueprints the player hasn't learned (blueprints that drop individually) sorted by category.
- FindUniqueBPs: Displays a list of items that can drop as individual blueprints and are not known by any faction.
- FindUniqueItems: Displays a list of ships/wings/weapons that are not known by any faction, regardless of the items' potential inclusion within a blueprint. (e.g. Zigg, XIV Legion, etc.)

- GetShipID: Gets the id of the specified ship.
- ShipEfficiency: Provides a list of the most efficient ships in certain categories. e.g. ships with the most favorable cargo capacity to monthly supply ratio.

- accAllHullmods: By default: adds all vanilla hullmods that aren't hidden or 'codex unlockable', Optional arguments to get hullmods from Mods and to obtain the 'codex unlockable' mods as well.
- AllCodexShips: Adds all codex visible ships to storage. This includes ships whose codex entries have not been unlocked.
- AllColonyItems: Adds all colony items to 'storage'.
- AllFactionItems: Adds all of the known weapons and wings of the specified faction to 'storage'.
- AllFactionShips: Adds all of the known ships of the specified faction to 'storage'.
- AllModItems: Adds all weapons and wings from the specified mod to Storage.
- AllModShips: Adds all ships from the specified mod to Storage.
- ClearStorage: Removes all items and ships from 'storage'.

- AddSkill, RemoveSkill, ViewSkills which let you add or remove individual skills to/from yourself, your officers, or your admins; and view all skills that your character currently has.

- AddPermaMod: Adds a perma mod to either a specified ship or all of the ships in your fleet. A third, optional argument 'smod' causes this perma-mod to be smodded.
- RemoveHullMod: Removes a hullmod from either a specified ship or all of the ships in your fleet.

- accFactions: Displays a sorted list of factions. Factions with markets, factions that are visible on the intel screen without markets, and hidden marketless factions that know at least 1 ship blueprint - a requirement intended to filter out irrelevant factions. Having nexerelin enabled will further truncate the 3rd category.
- FactionDoctrine: Displays the doctrine of the specified faction.
- FindColonyItems: Finds all installed colony items throughout the sector.
- SetContactRelation: Set the player's relationship with the named contact (or all of them) to a specified amount.

- AddPermaMember : Adds a permanent member to the specified alliance. If the second argument (faction) is left empty, then all current alliance members will become permanent.
- RemovePermaMember: Removes the specified faction from permanent membership in their faction. This does not remove them from the alliance altogether.
- SolidifyAlliance: Sets the relationships of all factions with the specified alliance to a minimum between 50-100.

- AddEntity: Adds an entity (stable locations, nav buoys, etc.) on the player's location, which either orbits the nearest star, or a specified object within the system.
- FindSalvageLocations: Prints a list of systems that contain Orbital Habitats, and Mining and Research Stations.
- SpawnAbyssEncounter: Spawns a specified Abyssal hyperspace encounter. Must use in the Abyss itself.
- SurveySalvageSystems: Fully surveys all planets in systems that contain Orbital Habitats, and Mining and Research Stations.

- ColonizePlanet: The specified faction will instantly form a colony of a specified size (or 3 if no second argument is provided) at either a specified planet, or a semi-random one if no third argument is provided.
- SpawnColonyFleet: Spawns a colony expedition from the specified faction to either a specified planet, or a semi-random one if no second argument is provided.

- ExposeHiddenTooltips: Will remove the 'limited_tooltip_if_locked' tag from all ships. Does not persist through game restarts.
- UnlockSimVariants: Unlocks all factions and ship variants for use in the simulator.

- accFastBuild: Runs the command 'FastBuild' while also undisrupting all industries.
- DisruptIndustry: Disrupts the specified industry for X amount of days.
- SetEventProgress: Sets the specified event's progress to a specific amount.
- ToggleTeleport: Upon activation, pressing CTRL + LMB will teleport the player's fleet to their mouse location.
- RestoreCorvusStorage: Toggles the usage of Corvus' Abandoned Terraforming Platform.

Use "help acc" to see all of the commands my mod adds.

Requires Console Commands.

Download Additional Console Commands

changelog.1.4.2:
- AddPermaMod and RemoveHullmod
   - Now can be used without specifying a ship to apply to the one currently selected in the refit menu.
      - This can be used to apply the commands to ship modules.
         - Using "All" as an argument will not apply changes to ship modules; they must be done individually.
changelog.1.4.1:
- New Survival Mode exclusive Command: RestoreCorvusStorage
   - Toggles the usage of Corvus' Abandoned Terraforming Platform.
changelog.1.4.0:
- Recompiled for 0.98.5a
- Thanks to a bugfix in 0.98.5a hullmods added through AddPermaMod no longer get un-perma'd when you adjust anything/re-open the refit screen.
